changelog: FIX (critical): Boot-loop on 1 GB Fire Stick Lite (Amazon AFTKM, AFTKM Lite). A user-traced boot-died report showed the DevBundleCache prewarm — Moshi-parsing 500 KB of bundled TMDB JSON (top-100 movies + top-100 TV + 397-entry image map) on the deferred-init thread — was taking 6.6 sec on AFTKM, pushing the process past the kernel's launch-budget watchdog and triggering a SIGKILL boot loop. Affected users saw the app open to a blank or partially-loaded home with no channels/categories/series/movies because the app died before the catalog finished populating. Fix: skip prewarm entirely on Lite-mode devices (they render the flat home with no big hero backdrops — the bundle benefit is marginal); on Pro-mode devices defer prewarm 5 sec past the first frame so it can't block boot.

INHERITED v1.44.141: #1 Java crash fix — IllegalStateException: 'FocusRequester is not initialized' (125/7d). Four declarative `Modifier.focusProperties { dir = X }` usages migrated to the safer `safeFocusTraversal` helper. Looper resilience wrapper restored as a defense-in-depth safety net.
